questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Iron is heated with sulphur to make iron sulphide.”
questions.explanation: Two elements combine into one new substance (Fe + S → FeS).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Magnesium burns in oxygen to make magnesium oxide.”
questions.explanation: Two substances combine into one (2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Copper is burnt in oxygen to make copper oxide.”
questions.explanation: Copper and oxygen combine into one compound (2Cu + O₂ → 2CuO).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Copper carbonate is heated into copper oxide and carbon dioxide.”
questions.explanation: One compound breaks into simpler products (CuCO₃ → CuO + CO₂).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Limestone is heated to make lime and carbon dioxide.”
questions.explanation: Calcium carbonate breaks down when heated (thermal decomposition).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Silver chloride breaks down in light into silver and chlorine.”
questions.explanation: One compound splits into two simpler products (2AgCl → 2Ag + Cl₂).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Zinc is added to sulphuric acid, giving zinc sulphate and hydrogen.”
questions.explanation: Zinc (more reactive) displaces hydrogen from the acid.

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “A more reactive metal pushes a less reactive element out of its compound.”
questions.explanation: The more reactive element takes the place of the less reactive one.

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Barium chloride reacts with magnesium sulphate to make barium sulphate and magnesium chloride.”
questions.explanation: Two compounds swap partners to make two new compounds.

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Two compounds change places to make two new compounds.”
questions.explanation: This is the definition of a double displacement reaction.

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “Methane burns in oxygen to make carbon dioxide and water.”
questions.explanation: A fuel reacts with oxygen giving heat and light (CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O).

questions.prompt: Reaction type: “A fuel reacts with oxygen in the air, giving out heat and light.”
questions.explanation: Combustion is burning — the fuel is oxidised.
